Name: Trees as Furniture (CustomFurniture pack)
Author: devilsandswords
Description:
[u]22/09/2018:[/u]  Over the next few weeks I hope to not only fix the issues that arise with the already existing code for these mods, but hopefully also convert them to Json Assets.
Until CustomFurniture updates i can do nothing about this mod and my flowerboxes mod, but I think converting this to Json Assets will get rid of the need for that.
If so, I will delete the original mod and reupload as Json Assets only, so there's no confusion.
Hope to see you again soon!


Ever wanted to plant trees inside your house? No? Too bad!

This small CustomFurniture pack allows you to place the vanilla trees inside your home and shed!
the trees included are:
Oak,
Maple,
Pine,
The large cherry tree used around the maps,
Mushroom,
and Palm!

The first four each have a choice between their different looks in seasons, so you can have a whole room of winter trees, or a mix of all the seasons if you wish!
